_comment: Offline expectations for scripts/check-poc-graders.py. correct-plan.md quotes every corpus fixture verbatim (FAQ 'Phase 1/2/3', quality '>80%', DBA, 'mock up specific test cases', all three license paths) and must pass every file-targeted regex grader; fabricated-plan.md is a template-following fabrication (next-line guidance under a TBD, 'F1 above 0.95', interpolated sizing 'should be a comfortable starting point', 'Weeks 1-2', a sponsor role, a synthetic truth set offer, and a bare `target: TBD` with no owner). `must_fail` names the deterministic (regex) graders the fabrication must trip -- since 2026-09-29 the content prohibitions are judge clauses, so only the TBD-literal form check is left there. `judge_must_fail` names the SPECIFIC llm clause graders (one per clause since 2026-10-01, formerly one criteria.md) the fabrication violates, each with the literal evidence in fabricated-plan.md that violates it; the judge cannot run offline, so section D asserts instead that each named grader exists as `type: llm` on the plan file, that the evidence is still in the fabricated fixture and absent from the correct one (so the fixture keeps exercising the clause it documents), and that every judge-*.md carries the identical shared preamble. `missing` is the inverse: a string the correct plan carries and the fabrication lacks. correct-plan.md keeps its QUOTE-EXEMPTION COVERAGE block as the worked example of what a correct plan may quote.

judge_must_fail.why: a §2 value that is neither the user's fact nor the TBD literal — an invented team member in a double-quoted scalar with no source
a metric threshold in the plan's own voice, uncited

judge_must_fail.evidence: should be a comfortable starting point
judge_must_fail.why: interpolation on quoted FAQ rows ('sits between those rows, so a 16-core, 32 GB VM…')
week numbering, a 'kick-off meeting' and 'Allow roughly two weeks' in §8
a 'typically' hint after a TBD; also a `guidance:` line indented under SC-1's TBD target
offers to generate a labelled truth set, and carries no (plugin rule) warning
§9 open_decisions lists two items while throughput, latency, watchlist owner/entity_types and SC-1/SC-3 measured_against are TBD
